title: About sexually transmitted infections
body: Sexually transmitted infections (STIs) are infections that can be passed mainly through sexual contact. Some infections may cause no symptoms, so testing and professional assessment can be important when exposure is possible.

title: Kuhusu magonjwa ya zinaa
body: Magonjwa ya zinaa (STI) ni maambukizi yanayoweza kuenea hasa kupitia ngono. Baadhi yanaweza kutokuwa na dalili, hivyo kupima na kupata ushauri wa mhudumu wa afya ni muhimu ikiwa kuna uwezekano wa kuambukizwa.

title: What is gonorrhoea?
body: Gonorrhoea is a sexually transmitted infection caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae. It can affect genital, rectal and throat sites. A laboratory test and clinical assessment are used to determine whether a person has gonorrhoea.

title: Kisonono ni nini?
body: Kisonono ni ugonjwa wa zinaa unaosababishwa na bakteria Neisseria gonorrhoeae. Unaweza kuathiri sehemu za siri, njia ya haja kubwa na koo. Kipimo cha maabara pamoja na tathmini ya mhudumu wa afya hutumika kubaini maambukizi.

title: Symptoms and testing
body: Gonorrhoea may cause pain or burning during urination or genital discharge, but some people have no symptoms. Symptoms alone cannot confirm gonorrhoea; appropriate testing and professional assessment are needed.

title: Dalili na kupima
body: Kisonono kinaweza kusababisha maumivu au kuungua wakati wa kukojoa au uchafu kutoka sehemu za siri, lakini baadhi ya watu hawana dalili. Dalili pekee haziwezi kuthibitisha kisonono; kipimo kinachofaa na tathmini ya mhudumu wa afya vinahitajika.

title: Prevention
body: Risk can be reduced through correct and consistent condom use, STI testing when appropriate, and communication with sexual partners. Local clinical guidance should be followed for testing, treatment and partner management.

title: Kujikinga
body: Hatari inaweza kupunguzwa kwa kutumia kondomu kwa usahihi na kila mara, kupima STI inapofaa, na kuwasiliana na wenzi wa ngono. Mwongozo wa kitabibu wa eneo husika unapaswa kufuatwa kuhusu vipimo, matibabu na usimamizi wa wenzi.
